dimensions.assessment: Applies to any persons engaging in commerce involving bear viscera, as well as wildlife enforcement agencies.
dimensions.evidence: it shall be unlawful for any person to ... import into, or export from, the United States bear viscera

dimensions.assessment: Establishes criminal penalties, civil fines of up to $25,000, and seizure and forfeiture provisions for violations.
dimensions.evidence: assessed a civil penalty by the Secretary of not more than $25,000 for each violation

dimensions.assessment: Penalties and fines collected are redirected to specific funds, but overall economic scale is limited.
dimensions.evidence: Sums received as penalties, fines, or forfeiture of property ... shall be used in accordance with section 6(d) of the Lacey Act Amendments

dimensions.assessment: Creates a new federal prohibition, enforcement mechanisms, and regulatory duties for the Secretary of the Interior.
dimensions.evidence: The Secretary shall ... issue such regulations as are necessary to carry out this Act.

dimensions.assessment: Permanent federal prohibition and conservation framework.

importance_detail.rationale: Imposes new federal prohibitions and penalties on the import, export, and interstate trade of bear viscera and related products to conserve global bear populations.
